title: Playful Valentine micro-app (4-screen flow with dodging NO + YES celebration)

requirements.summary: Implement a 4-step single-page flow with gentle, button-driven transitions and no backend calls.
acceptanceCriteria: App starts on an Intro screen and progresses forward via user actions only (no page reloads required).
The flow includes Intro, Build-up, Big Question, and Sweet Ending screens; Sweet Ending is shown after the YES celebration (or via a clear continue action after YES).
All screen transitions are smooth and feel "gentle" (no harsh flashing or jarring motion).

file_operations.description: Create the single-page state-driven flow (Intro → Build-up → Big Question → Sweet Ending) with gentle transitions, ensuring navigation is only via button clicks and does not perform any backend calls.
Create a shared screen layout wrapper (centered content, consistent spacing) and a simple transition container to keep screen changes gentle and visually consistent.
Ensure the app renders the new App component cleanly and that providers do not interfere with the single-page, click-driven flow (no authentication prompts or backend calls triggered by the flow).

requirements.summary: Create the Intro screen with exact specified text and a “Continue” button advancing to Build-up.
acceptanceCriteria: Intro screen displays the specified text exactly (including emoji) and a “Continue” button.
Clicking “Continue” moves to the Build-up screen.

file_operations.description: Create the Intro screen UI with the exact text “Hi Anya 💕\nI made a tiny app just to ask you something…” and a single primary “Continue” button that advances the flow.
Wire IntroScreen into the flow as the initial screen and connect the “Continue” action to navigate to the Build-up screen.

requirements.summary: Create the Build-up screen with exact specified text and an “I’m ready” button advancing to Big Question.
acceptanceCriteria: Build-up screen displays the specified text exactly (including emoji) and an “I’m ready” button.
Clicking “I’m ready” moves to the Big Question screen.

file_operations.description: Create the Build-up screen UI with the exact text “This is a very serious question.\nPlease answer honestly 😌” and a single primary “I’m ready” button that advances the flow.
Wire BuildUpScreen into the flow and connect “I’m ready” to navigate to the Big Question screen.

requirements.summary: Create the Big Question screen with prominent centered question text, YES/NO buttons, and subtle helper text.
acceptanceCriteria: Big Question screen shows the question text centered and visually prominent.
Buttons render with labels exactly: “YES 💕” and “NO”.
The helper line appears under the buttons and is visually subtle compared to the main question.

file_operations.description: Create the Big Question screen UI with big, bold centered text “Anya, will you be my Valentine? 💝”, two buttons labeled exactly “YES 💕” and “NO”, and subtle helper text “(Just kidding… but I really hope you say yes 🥺)”.
Wire BigQuestionScreen into the flow and connect YES/NO interactions to the appropriate in-app behaviors (YES triggers celebration sequence; NO triggers dodge behavior handled within the screen).

requirements.summary: Implement the NO button dodge interaction within bounded area without shifting layout; YES remains stationary.
acceptanceCriteria: Attempting to interact with NO (pointerenter/mouseover on desktop, pointerdown/touchstart on mobile, and/or click) causes NO to move away instead of being clicked.
NO’s new position always remains fully visible (not off-screen) and stays within a defined container/bounds.
YES remains fixed in place during NO dodging interactions.
NO behavior does not cause layout shifts that move the question text or YES button.

file_operations.description: Create a hook that computes safe randomized positions for the NO button inside a bounded container and exposes handlers for pointerenter and pointerdown/touchstart to trigger evasion without causing layout shifts.

Integrate dodging behavior: render NO as absolutely positioned within a fixed-size/relative bounds container; bind pointer interactions to move it, keeping the YES button in a stable, non-moving position.
Add minimal CSS to support stable layout (fixed button row sizing), smooth NO movement transitions (gentle transform/translate), and prevent jarring motion while preserving readability.

requirements.summary: Show brief, playful randomized feedback messages near the buttons after each NO dodge with auto-fade.
acceptanceCriteria: After each NO dodge, one message from the list appears and then disappears automatically.
Messages rotate randomly or pseudo-randomly and do not always repeat the same one.
Message styling matches the app’s cute/playful tone and does not appear aggressive or guilt-inducing.

file_operations.description: Create a small message component to display one randomized message at a time near the buttons, with an auto-fade/auto-hide animation.
After each NO dodge, randomly select and show exactly one of: “Hey hey hey 😳”, “Nice try”, “That button is shy”, “Wrong choice detected 🚫”, “The universe says no… to NO”, then auto-hide it.
Add gentle fade-in/fade-out styling/animation for the dodge feedback messages to keep tone cute and motion non-overwhelming.

requirements.summary: On YES click: confetti burst, hearts rain, vibration (if supported), then show exact success + follow-up text and remove NO interaction.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking YES triggers a visible confetti effect and a visible hearts-rain effect.
On supported devices, a vibration occurs; on unsupported devices, the app continues without errors.
After the celebration begins, the success message and follow-up text are shown exactly as specified.
After YES is clicked, the NO button is no longer relevant (either hidden/disabled or the screen content changes so it can’t be interacted with).

file_operations.description: Create a lightweight on-screen confetti burst effect (frontend-only) that can be triggered from the YES action.
Create a hearts-raining overlay animation (frontend-only) that runs after YES is clicked; use the generated heart sticker icon as a visual element where appropriate.

Create a celebration view that triggers confetti + hearts rain and shows the exact message “Best decision ever 🥰\nHappy Valentine’s Day, Anya ❤️” and the follow-up text “Dinner / chocolate / cuddles are officially planned 😏”.

Wire YES to transition into the celebration view, call the browser vibration API safely (feature-detected), and ensure NO is hidden/disabled by switching screen content so NO can’t be interacted with after YES.

requirements.summary: Add Sweet Ending screen with exact text and a clear path to reach it after YES celebration (delay or Continue).
acceptanceCriteria: Sweet Ending screen displays the specified text exactly (including emoji).
User can reliably reach the Sweet Ending after clicking YES (either automatically after the celebration or via an explicit button).

file_operations.description: Create the Sweet Ending screen UI with the exact text “I promise this app is the only thing that won’t let you say no 😉\nThank you for being you.”
Add a gentle, clear path to Sweet Ending after the celebration (either an automatic timed transition after a short delay and/or a visible “Continue” action).
Wire SweetEndingScreen into the flow and ensure it is reachable after the YES celebration via the chosen continue mechanism.

requirements.summary: Apply consistent cute Valentine visual theme (pink/red/soft purple), rounded typography, and gentle animations without pushy tone.
acceptanceCriteria: All screens share a consistent palette (pink/red/soft purple) and rounded, friendly typography.
Animations (screen transitions, message fades, button motions) are smooth and not overly fast or intense.
Copy and interactions feel playful rather than coercive; no additional text beyond what’s specified is added that increases pressure.

file_operations.description: Define global theme tokens and base styles for a Valentine palette (pink/red/soft purple), rounded friendly typography, and gentle animation timings; ensure no additional pushy microcopy is introduced via styling elements.
Extend Tailwind theme (colors/radius/animations) to support the Valentine palette and softer rounded visuals consistently across screens.
Ensure consistent spacing, readable contrast over backgrounds, and gentle transition behaviors across all screens using the shared layout wrapper.

requirements.summary: Add optional soft romantic background music with visible mute/unmute control; default muted or requires user action; does not reset screen state.
acceptanceCriteria: A mute/unmute (or play/pause) control is visible and works.
Music does not autoplay with sound without a user gesture; initial state is muted or not playing until user interacts.
Toggling audio does not reset the current screen state.

file_operations.description: Implement a small audio controller hook (using HTMLAudioElement or Web Audio) that starts only after explicit user interaction, defaults to muted/not playing, and exposes toggle controls without affecting the app’s screen state.
Create a small on-screen mute/unmute (or play/pause) control UI that connects to the romantic music hook and stays visible across screens.
Render the AudioToggle persistently within the app shell so audio can be toggled at any time without changing the current screen, and ensure playback only starts after a user gesture.

requirements.summary: Add generated static visual assets under frontend/public/assets/generated and visibly use at least one background/pattern in the UI theme.
acceptanceCriteria: Generated images exist under frontend/public/assets/generated with the specified filenames.
At least one generated background/pattern asset is visibly used in the app styling (without harming readability).

file_operations.description: Add the generated image asset file at frontend/public/assets/generated/valentine-pattern.dim_1600x900.png.
Add the generated image asset file at frontend/public/assets/generated/valentine-gradient-bg.dim_1600x900.png.
Add the generated image asset file at frontend/public/assets/generated/heart-sticker-icon.dim_256x256.png.

Wire the generated backgrounds into the app styling by applying at least one of the generated background assets (frontend/public/assets/generated/valentine-pattern.dim_1600x900.png and/or frontend/public/assets/generated/valentine-gradient-bg.dim_1600x900.png) in a way that preserves text readability.
Use the generated heart icon asset (frontend/public/assets/generated/heart-sticker-icon.dim_256x256.png) as a themed element in the hearts rain animation and/or subtle decorative UI.
